## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when
one exists.

## Validation

List the commands or scenarios used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, or tests are not applicable.
- [ ] User documentation is updated, or documentation is not affected.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for a user-visible change, or not applicable.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private consumer code, or generated build artifacts.
